procedural_matters: BEL 18 was represented by Isaura MAENHAUT.
FRA 19 was represented by Mathilde LOVADINA.
Sophie STEINLEIN (GER 5) was a witness for BEL 18.
FRA 19 provided video evidence of the incident.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 3 - 5 knots of wind and flat water.
Approaching mark 1, BEL 18 and FRA 19 were sailing on port tack, with BEL 18 two boat lengths clear ahead and two boat lengths to leeward of FRA 19.
BEL 18 entered the zone and tacked onto starboard tack one boat length above the starboard layline.
Immediately after BEL 18 tacked, FRA 19 luffed and passed head to wind.
Before FRA 19 reached a close-hauled course, BEL 18 luffed and the minimum distance between the boats was 20 cm.
conclusions: When acquiring right-of-way through her own actions, BEL 18 luffed to give FRA 19 room to keep clear, as required by RRS 15.
